resource.name: davinci-aac-support

resource.description: Linux background watcher that detects imported AAC media, converts audio to PCM with FFmpeg and relinks clips through Resolve scripting. Leaves compatible video streams unchanged. Requires Python 3, FFmpeg/ffprobe and a systemd user service. Creator claims Free/Studio support; Resolve 21.1 scripting restrictions require a separate compatibility check.
